## Summary

Replace the generic enemy inspector with the authored panel and confirmation flow, completing the runtime UI slice of original491b002 after #63–67.

```text
Stats ↔ Enemy Info
suggested on → read-only fields
suggested off → manual fields +quadratic sliders
request suggestions → confirmation →Yes applies /No preserves
                                    →resume current playhead
```

Preserve existing save/import arithmetic and transient suggestion mode.

## Evidence

- Formatting, TypeScript,510 rule tests (6,184 assertions), production build and all12 final native/mock browser cases pass in2.4minutes without skips. The final two modal flows additionally pass36.9s after hiding the overlapping legacy Export aid.
- Browser checks cover source panel/field geometry, non-primary tab guards, readonly/manual values, trailing-dot speed drafts, sliders, No/Yes, save/reopen, stale suggestion save recomputation, placement/cancellation, palette validation and saved-copy medals. Final native/mock panel and confirmation captures were inspected.
- Source listeners activate when opening starts. A clock-controlled early response preserves the frame12 stop; Yes/No resume rather than force a closing jump. Closing/reopening the panel clears that state.
- Source913 has button cutouts. Numerical mock masks and two native open poses without the hovered button let rollover art replace normal art. Screen-pixel regressions verify source white alpha153 normal/57 rollover in both modes; the old mock rectangle approach fails by30 color levels. The expanded39-entry native gallery verifies both excluded-button cutouts are transparent.
- Uses the existing imported layout, font identity, native caches and manual rules. Palette actions close the advanced panel; accepted saving still recomputes enabled suggestions from the final geometry.
- Legacy JSON export hides only while confirmation is visible and returns afterwards. Original save/share dialogs, full Flash text/selection, complete constructor/event timing and controlled original-screen comparison remain pending. No source media, contours, generated data or saved-design schema changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the generic inspector; saved designs and source calculation helpers remain compatible.

**Blast Radius:** editor

Enemy panel rendering and input change. Avatar saving, placement, validation and medals are covered by the affected browser checks.

```text
enter creator → persist first-use latch → six stopped guide pages
edit → source-ordered validation → accept part snapshot or reconstruct previous parts
Undo → previous parts, retained enemy statistics
Save → attachment/body checks → existing local save/code dialog
alert → independent 2000ms Timer → retained frame-based fade
workspace artwork → scoped minimum stroke → complete registered border behind input canvas
```

Preserve current palette/details registration, live artwork and sibling modal ownership. Import numeric tutorial/alert metadata through repeatable tools. Restore the complete recreation objective and continuation documentation without claiming full parity.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the older guide JSON fails the independent parent-placement regression; creator flows omit first-use onboarding and source edit rejection/history.

Production build and **20 distinct focused native/mock browser cases** passed, followed by the **115-case broad offline run (8.6m)**. After the isolated paint correction, **17 distinct affected native/mock browser cases** pass without skips; two fresh workspace cases pass in18.8s. The broad run predates that paint correction.
- The CI job allows **35 minutes** for the expanded115-case browser suite. The full suite, assertions, worker count and per-test timeouts are preserved; the first hosted run hit its former20-minute job limit.
- Fresh original-game captures cover **29 stopped guide/save/validation states**, with zero page errors. Original screenshots confirm rejected spending rollback, Undo and same-versus-distinct behavior validation. Native guide/alert foreground registration was visually inspected against those captures.
- Numeric imports repeat byte for byte; existing dialog frames are preserved. All56 original paths have explicit recovery/disposition. No original SWF, extracted media, captures, dependencies or build output are committed.
- **Workspace before:** axis contrast0.035 versus the original0.803. **After:** actual550×450 editor axis/border contrast0.800/0.098 versus original0.803/0.104. Six frame checks preserve alpha/registration/raw raster/Script bounds and ordinary caller paint. Both native images were inspected.
- `docs/fidelity.md` records limits: scaled circle thickness still differs, and Ruffle tessellation-cache history is not reconstructed. Full input/constructor/event timing, Adobe pixel equality and a synchronized ordinary-input playthrough remain unproven. Installed runtime identities do not establish execution of every renderer variant.

Revertable editor/UI changes. The profile adds a first-use boolean with a safe missing-field default; saved tank format remains compatible.

## Summary

Preserve Healer behavior when NPC data clears before its display clip detaches. Existing beams retain their home and patient through owner death or jam; known deactivated-data reads interrupt only the current World listener.

```text
NPC Deactivate
  primary final callbacks → clear part targets → clear data → queue removal
Healer read / AddLife
  preserve source try/catch boundary and increment-before-error order
Existing beam
  direct home + patient → contact while parented → remove on detach
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** The initial seven-case regression suite on unchanged master passed the healthy control and failed six lifecycle cases. Queued dead patients advanced later work, and dead/jammed homes incorrectly removed existing beams.
  **After:** 13 lifecycle regressions pass, including outgoing/incoming crossing, escaping catch retry, signed integer assignment, primary callback ordering, allied boundary exit and arbitrary host-error propagation.
- **Before:** Patient data and retained artwork were represented by the same always-readable metadata.
  **After:** Explicit data availability preserves immutable rendering metadata and parent lifetime. Actual shell contact records life1/counter10 with later bullet/avatar age0, followed by detach and recovery.
- Formatting, TypeScript, **750 unit tests / 7,473 assertions**, production build and **10 affected mock/SWF browser cases without skips** passed. Both new galleries were inspected; same-pose omission controls verify beam paint after healthy, killed and jammed owner states.
- Evidence comes from decompiled source/exported Healer protected ranges and recreation execution. No new original-runtime differential is claimed. Broader infection/final-callback ordering, complete allied deactivation callbacks and full-game parity remain documented work.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revertible code and fixture change; no profile migration or generated/media assets.

**Blast Radius:** combat

Changes NPC target cleanup, Healer data reads, AddLife integer assignment and immediate beam removal. Raw candidate order, held references and live-array iteration remain intentional.
